description: Use this when a homeowner asks how a HELOC works, how it differs from a home equity loan, what documents lenders ask for, how long it takes, how a reverse mortgage or home equity investment works, or whether a rate or fees they were quoted, or a rate they saw, look typical. Do not use for purchase mortgages, refinancing a first mortgage, rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Explanations are general information. For quoted terms, the rate (percent) and fees (US dollars) are set against the advertised range for the state and product. Not advice on a specific loan, and not an offer. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

quoted_amount_usd.description: The loan amount the quote is for, in US dollars.

quoted_fees_usd.description: The one-time fees the lender quoted, in US dollars.

quoted_product.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

quoted_rate_percent.description: The rate the lender quoted, annual percent.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

topic.description: What to explain. evaluate_quoted_terms checks a quote against advertised rates; give state, quoted_product and quoted_rate_percent.

name: explain_home_equity

as_of.description: Date the catalog's newest figure was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

confidence.description: high when nothing that would change the result is missing, medium when one thing is, low when more are or the state is not covered.

general_information.description: Always true: this is general information.

non_partner_options_included.description: True when the result draws on lenders that pay Alauda nothing.

not_an_offer.description: Always true: nothing here is an offer.

ranking_basis.description: How any list in this result is ordered.

who_pays_us.description: Who pays Alauda. Show it with any lender or rate information.

ignored_fields.description: Parameters dropped because they looked like an SSN or a street address, or because this tool no longer takes them: names only, the first 5.

inputs_used.description: The inputs this result was computed from.

response_requirements.description: Rules any reply built on this result keeps.

quote_check.description: Absent unless topic is evaluate_quoted_terms with state and quoted_product.

advertised.description: Low, median and high advertised rate for the state and product, each with its page and date. Absent with no entries.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.
Page the figure was read from.

typical.description: Absent when the result would not fit with it.

pct.description: The median advertised rate in percent: the middle entry's, or the average of the two middle entries'.

high.description: Computed by Alauda: the highest, the same way.

low.description: Computed by Alauda: the lowest one-time fees among those entries at quoted_amount_usd, in percent of it; the fees are catalog terms with no recorded page or date.

entries_used.description: Catalog entries with an advertised rate for the state and product.

quoted_fees_pct_of_amount.description: Computed by Alauda: quoted_fees_usd over quoted_amount_usd, in percent. Absent without both.

rate_position.description: Absent without quoted_rate_percent or advertised rates.

source.description: Where the points' figures come from. Absent for general copy.
